shared_elements: upright slab/stele with figural carving on one face
animal figures arranged in registers/stacked one above another
justification: Both surfaces are upright stelae bearing profile quadrupeds stacked vertically, which is about the only correspondence, and it is a generic one. A shows isolated, bare relief animals (a bull-like beast above a fox-like beast and possibly a crane) on an otherwise empty field, whereas B shows a narrative scene of a mounted rider greeted by figures above a large panel of dense interlaced ribbon-animal ornament framed by borders — no shared specific motif, relationship or decorative convention.
